correctness.rationale: Truncating each of 30 icosahedral edges into two oriented endpoint vertices yields 60 vertices and a cubic 90-edge graph. Independently enumerated cliques of its graph square (distance<=2) and obtained face vector (60,270,340,120,12), Euler characteristic 22. Retrieved actual certificate.json at blob d7e6158a... and independently replayed ALL 120 ordered elementary collapses: in each step smaller simplex was present with the single strict coface exactly the asserted larger simplex; verified 2D residual f-vector (60,270,232). For simple connectivity, every new distance-two edge can be replaced by two original edges inside a 2-simplex; the icosahedral truncation has 12 pentagon and 20 hexagon facial disks, with each pentagonal loop contained in a 4-simplex and each hexagonal loop filled by four specified triangles. These loops normally generate pi1 of the original embedded graph on S2. Thus pi1=0. Euler=22 and 2D collapse imply free H2 rank 21; Hurewicz and the simply connected homological Whitehead theorem upgrade this to wedge^21 S2.
residual_risks: Relies on the stated standard icosahedron truncation as the closed 2-sphere polyhedral embedding; source checker supplies edge and vertex-link audits.
